parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for pure Node ESM .mjs files in /output, manual process.argv parsing, no external dependencies, and character-level executable compatibility.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent created tasks for probing, implementation, and verification, launched a workflow for exhaustive executable probing, and kept local ownership of source creation and artifact assembly.
parallel.implementation: The parent built a layered implementation with jsonschema, Python argparse, repr, traceback, linecache, and JSON decoder modules plus test8.mjs and a diff harness.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied test8.mjs, tools/diff.mjs, and local library modules; no final text response was written, but the artifact tree existed.
parallel.verification: The workflow produced initial probe specs and a critic, but the second follow-up wave did not aggregate; local diff reached 233/234 before another linecache-active diff was killed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow state ended killed with result null, the final verifier task was pending, and official evaluation still failed 156 of 157 cases.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual argv, no external dependency, /output delivery, and executable-aligned behavior requirements from the shared prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows and delegation disabled, one actor performed exploration, implementation, integration, and verification in a single local sequence.
serial.implementation: The serial run wrote test8.mjs and library modules for argparse, Python JSON behavior, jsonschema validation, traceback, values, and linecache behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied test8.mjs, fuzz.mjs, difftest.mjs, and local libraries; final.txt was empty but the expected entry was present.
serial.verification: The serial run reached 370/370 deterministic differential cases and 500/500 random fuzz cases before trying extra seeded fuzzing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was killed during additional fuzzing and still officially failed 156 of 157 cases, so local verification did not establish official acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the ESM .mjs, manual argv, executable probing, zero-dependency, and /output placement requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had the identical prompt and recognized the same implementation and black-box executable constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is established; later differences come from work allocation and verification budget.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent split the work into parent tasks and a large workflow of behavior-probing children while retaining implementation ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had workflows disabled and no delegation, so one actor owned probing, implementation, verification, and delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a broad verifier/prober coordination layer; serial kept the same obligations on the local critical path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were behavioral probes with schemas and hard rules, then the critic converted initial probe results into gap-specific follow-ups.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not pass context through child boundaries; it directly encoded discovered behavior into the local implementation and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more context-transfer surfaces, but no retained context-loss or interface-contract failure is evidenced; the issue was the unfinished follow-up workflow.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced a multi-module port including test8.mjs, diff tooling, jsonschema modules, Python argparse/repr/traceback/linecache modules, and JSON modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced a similar multi-module port plus deterministic and fuzz harnesses, with implementation fixes driven by local diff failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented comparable module families, but serial reached a more internally validated implementation path before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow completed initial results and the critic, then launched nine follow-up children and ended killed with result null.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to retrieve; local test results were immediately available in the main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the aggregate verifier lifecycle at the workflow boundary, while serial avoided a join/return dependency.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact validation shows the final submitted tree was present and owned by the parent; probe children were not source writers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation also shows a coherent submitted tree with test8.mjs, harnesses, and local libraries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material shared-state collision or overwrite difference is supported; both final trees were copied as artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel local verification reached 233/234 in one diff context and was killed during the subsequent linecache-active rerun.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verification reached 370/370 deterministic cases and 500/500 fuzz cases before an extra multi-seed fuzz run was killed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger local acceptance evidence, while parallel verification was shortened by unfinished workflow and interrupted diff work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent budget on 15 workflow agents and was killed near closure with workflow result null and a pending verification task.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent no child budget and was killed during extra seeded fuzzing after completing its main deterministic and random checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel closure pressure is tied to broad follow-up fan-out, whereas serial closure pressure came after larger local checks had already completed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed evaluator records are not discordant: both parallel and serial failed with 1 of 157 samples passing. The concrete task-solving contrast is process and local verification depth: parallel built an artifact but exhausted budget through a broad verifier workflow and was interrupted at 233/234 plus a killed rerun, while serial avoided delegation and reached 370/370 plus 500/500 fuzz before extra fuzzing was killed.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out consumed child tokens and elapsed budget and ended with result null.
Parent local verification remained incomplete at closure, including a killed linecache-active diff rerun.
serial_contributors: Single-actor execution avoided result join and workflow-return dependencies.
Local deterministic and fuzz verification completed before the final timeout event.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both artifacts still failed the official hidden evaluator at the same 1/157 score, so remaining correctness defects cannot be uniquely attributed to coordination from permitted evidence.
evaluator_effects: The official score is identical despite different local verification depth; no permitted raw case-level evaluator failures expose a discordant cause.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported adverse parallel process difference only
